entities.summary: Sudan is a sovereign nation in North Africa, Africa. Its capital is Khartoum. Official languages include Arabic, English. Government: Transitional (contested; civil war between SAF and RSF since April 2023). Population: approximately 49.0 million. Area: 1,886,068 km². Comprehensive index for Sudan covering Kingdom of Kush (Meroe and Napata), Nubian Christian kingdoms (Makuria, Alodia, Nobatia), Islamic sultanates (Funj, Darfur), Turco-Egyptian rule, Mahdist State, Anglo-Egyptian Condominium, independence 1956, Abboud and Nimeiry military eras, Omar al-Bashir (30-year Islamist rule), Darfur genocide, South Sudan secession 2011, 2019 revolution, and 2023 civil war (RSF vs SAF).

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Sudan's tumultuous history has shaped regional dynamics, with its Islamic sultanates and Turco-Egyptian rule influencing neighboring countries. The country's modern civil war has resulted in significant human suffering and displacement.
